disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the rules and orders of the Commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person failing to comply with the rules and orders of the Commissioner shall be guilty of a violation of KRS 252.180 to 252.240.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resisting or hindering the Commissioner or authorized representative in the discharge of duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any and all persons who shall resist, or hinder the Commissioner or his duly authorized representative in the discharge of his duties under the provisions of KRS 252.180 to 252.240 shall be guilty of a violation of KRS 252.180 to 252.240

disciplinary_grounds.description: Bringing bees or apiary equipment into the state in violation of the statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: bees or combs, used hives, or other used apiary appliances brought into this state in violation of the provisions of KRS 252.180 to 252.240 shall be confiscated and destroyed.

definition_quote.value: "Bees" means any stage of the common hive or honey bee (apis mellifica) or other bees kept for the production of honey or wax
definition_quote.quote: "Bees" means any stage of the common hive or honey bee (apis mellifica) or other bees kept for the production of honey or wax

registration_required.quote: The Commissioner may establish a schedule of registration fees to be used for carrying out the provisions of KRS 252.180 to 252.240.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Such infected bees, hives, honey and appliances shall be deemed a public nuisance.

regulated_diseases.quote: "Bee diseases" means American or European foul brood, sacbrood, bee paralysis, disappearing disease, Isle of Wight disease, or any other disease or abnormal condition of the egg, larval, pupal or adult stages of bees

disease_reporting_required.quote: The Commissioner may order persons owning or possessing bees to report information the Commissioner deems necessary for the discharge of his duties under the provisions of KRS 252.180 to 252.240.

quarantine_authority.quote: the Commissioner may establish and maintain quarantines prohibiting the shipment into or within the state, or any subdivision thereof of any bees, queen bees, used hives or any part thereof, used appliances or any material capable of transmitting any bee diseases

inspector_police_powers.quote: The state apiarist and deputy state apiarists shall be vested with the powers of police officers in the enforcement of the provisions of KRS 252.180 to 252.240.

right_of_entry_scope.quote: no occupied dwelling may be entered without a search warrant
